    A standard round brilliant has 57 or 58 facets. Our Portuguese cut has 161+ facets — each cut and polished individually. The extra facets reflect and refract light from many more angles, which is why it earns the title of the world's brightest diamond.

    Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically and optically identical to mined — pure crystallised carbon. They test as real on every standard diamond tester; only a specialist laboratory machine detecting nitrogen presence can tell them apart.
